meshes.label: Camera pocket shims
meshes.note: Depth shims behind the module, print only: 36 × 36 mm at 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.6 mm with the same 24 × 14 window. They stack to 2.8 mm in 0.4 mm steps, so a 9.5 or 10 mm camera still clamps solid in the 11.3 mm pocket. Shared by the corner mast and the wrist arch. Three shims on one plate, which is why the print check WARNs "3 bodies".
